title: General or unclear symptoms
content: A general physician is a good first contact for common, mild, new, or unclear symptoms and can assess whether another specialty is appropriate.
symptom_examples: fever; fatigue; weakness; cold; cough; several symptoms; unsure which doctor; general checkup

title: Heart and circulation concerns
content: A cardiologist evaluates symptoms related to the heart and circulation. This navigation suggestion does not identify the cause of symptoms.
symptom_examples: chest discomfort; palpitations; racing heartbeat; irregular heartbeat; breathlessness with activity; blood pressure concern

title: Hormone and blood sugar concerns
content: An endocrinologist evaluates hormone-related concerns, including thyroid and blood sugar questions.
symptom_examples: thyroid; unexplained weight change; excessive thirst; frequent urination; blood sugar; diabetes; hormonal concern

title: Diabetes care
content: A diabetologist focuses on diabetes care and blood sugar management. A clinician should interpret symptoms and test results.
symptom_examples: diabetes follow up; high sugar; glucose readings; insulin; diabetes consultation; blood sugar control

title: Nervous system concerns
content: A neurologist evaluates concerns involving the brain, spinal cord, and nerves.
symptom_examples: headache; migraine; dizziness; numbness; tingling; tremor; seizure; weakness in a limb

title: Bones joints and muscles
content: An orthopedist evaluates concerns involving bones, joints, muscles, and injuries.
symptom_examples: joint pain; knee pain; back pain; shoulder pain; fracture; sprain; stiffness; difficulty moving a joint

title: Skin hair and nail concerns
content: A dermatologist evaluates concerns involving the skin, hair, and nails.
symptom_examples: rash; itching; acne; skin irritation; hair loss; nail changes; skin spots

title: Stomach and digestive concerns
content: A gastroenterologist evaluates concerns involving digestion, the stomach, intestines, and related organs.
symptom_examples: stomach pain; abdominal discomfort; indigestion; nausea; heartburn; bowel changes; digestive problem

title: Kidney concerns
content: A nephrologist evaluates kidney-related concerns. A clinician should review symptoms, history, and any laboratory results.
symptom_examples: kidney concern; swelling; changes in urination; kidney disease follow up; renal concern

title: Eye and vision concerns
content: An ophthalmologist evaluates concerns involving the eyes and vision.
symptom_examples: blurred vision; eye pain; redness; vision changes; difficulty seeing; eye irritation
